description: Across the country, concerns about large AI data centers are growing. In West Virginia, Governor Morrisey continues to tout such centers as a bonanza for our state. Unfortunately, in 2025, House Bill 2014 made it easier for data centers to come into West Virginia in secret. While there are legitimate concerns about electricity, water use, rising local costs, noise generated by these facilities, and the number of jobs that will be created, West Virginians will probably never know the truth about
title: On Data Centers
